hooks.name: CDK Diff Safety Review
hooks.description: When any CDK infrastructure file is edited, reminds the agent to run cdk diff before deploying and check for unintended resource deletions — especially stateful resources like Neptune, OpenSearch, EFS, and S3.

action.prompt:
SAFETY CHECK: A CDK infrastructure file was modified. Before running `cdk deploy`, you MUST:
1. Run `cdk diff <StackName>` and review the output
2. Check for ANY resource deletions (lines starting with `[-]`)
3. Verify ALL stateful resources (Neptune, OpenSearch, EFS, S3, KMS) have `removalPolicy: RETAIN`
4. If migrating a resource out of CDK management, confirm the two-step pattern was followed (deploy RETAIN first, then remove)
5. Run CDK assertion tests (`npx jest` in infrastructure/cdk/)

This hook exists because of the April 22, 2026 Neptune data loss incident. See docs/postmortem/2026-04-22-neptune-data-loss.md
